info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Clinopt Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Clinopt Syrup Detail Management API enables businesses to create and manage detailed entries for Clinopt Syrup products in their catalog. This API allows users to define specific attributes such as dosage, packaging, and other relevant information essential for product identification. Typically utilized by pharmaceutical companies and healthcare providers, this endpoint facilitates the seamless integration of product data into inventory systems. Implementing this API streamlines creating new product entries, ensuring accurate and timely information is available for consumers.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create new details for Clinopt syrup, including all necessary attributes and specifications. Ensure that all required fields are properly filled in the request body to avoid validation errors.
